Title: Highfield Therapy
Paragraph: Welcome to Highfield Therapy. My name is Robert, I am a qualified registrant counsellor with NCPS and follow their code of ethics. I am a humanistic therapist with a focus on Transactional Analysis (TA), and I provide professional therapy services to help you navigate life's challenges. I am committed to attending regular training and CPD and learning more about how I can help people. I offer online counselling, but I also offer counselling from home in a private garden room where you can talk openly about your concerns. I am a 20-minute walk from Sheffield Central station or close to a tram stop. There is plenty of free on-street parking. Price £50, but offer concessions to those on low or no income.
Second_Title: Online or face-to-face counselling sessions available. I can arrange a 15 minute phone consultation to talk more about how I can help you and answer any questions you may have about therapy. Then I can book an in-person or online appointment. In Sheffield, call or message 07946827431 or use the email button below
